en.title: A warehouse in a shoebox for our semantic layer
en.shortdesc: How the whole stack runs offline: a patched BigQuery emulator, a RAM-backed store, and a traffic generator that keeps the data moving.
en.longdesc: Part 8 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: the local harness involving patching a BigQuery emulator so dbt runs on it, capping storage with tmpfs, and feeding it realistic moving data from a parquet landing zone.
en.seoDescription: Running a semantic-layer stack offline: a patched BigQuery emulator, tmpfs storage caps and a traffic generator. Part 8 of a series.
